ops.new:
-- 1.1.6 (the owner: an NPC yell in the chat showed "سوی شهر برایت خبر آورده ام" on the first
-- line and "از آن" under it - the start of the sentence went to the end): a chat window wraps
-- a long line by itself, left to right, and a shaped (visual order) Persian line wrapped that
-- way reads last-part-first. So a chat line is wrapped HERE, by our own measure at the
-- window's width and font size, every line shaped on its own (T.Lines, the tooltip rule). A
-- text that does not fit after the "Name says:" prefix (prefixLen letters) starts on its
-- own line. frame = the chat window (nil: a 420 px default).
function T.ChatText(text, frame, prefixLen)
    local mode = T.Mode()
    local w, size = 420, 14
    if frame then
        local okw, fw = pcall(frame.GetWidth, frame)
        if okw and F.Usable(fw) and type(fw) == "number" and fw > 60 then
            w = fw
        end
        local okf, _, fsz = pcall(frame.GetFont, frame)
        if okf and F.Usable(fsz) and type(fsz) == "number" and fsz > 4 then
            size = fsz
        end
    end
    local avail = (w - 12) * 0.94
    local pre = (tonumber(prefixLen) or 0) * size * 0.5
    local one = T.Lines(text, math.max(80, avail - pre), size, mode)
    if type(one) ~= "table" or #one <= 1 then
        return (type(one) == "table" and one[1]) or T.ShapeLine(text, mode)
    end
    local lines = T.Lines(text, avail, size, mode)
    return (pre > 0 and "\n" or "") .. table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

ops.new:
-- 1.1.6 (the owner: a long Persian text the game wraps by itself reads last-part-first): a
-- fontstring that wraps (CanWordWrap) and has a width gets its lines wrapped HERE, each one
-- shaped on its own (T.Lines); a one-line string keeps one shaped line as before
local function wrap_width(fs)
    if not fs then
        return nil
    end
    local okc, can = pcall(function()
        return fs.CanWordWrap and fs:CanWordWrap()
    end)
    if not (okc and F.Usable(can) and can == true) then
        return nil
    end
    local okw, w = pcall(fs.GetWidth, fs)
    if okw and F.Usable(w) and type(w) == "number" and w > 40 then
        return w
    end
    return nil
end

local function shape(fa, fs)
    local out = {}
    local w = wrap_width(fs)
    local size = 12
    if w then
        local okf, _, sz = pcall(fs.GetFont, fs)
        if okf and F.Usable(sz) and type(sz) == "number" and sz > 4 then
            size = sz
        end
    end
    for line in string.gmatch(fa .. "\n", "(.-)\n") do
        if w then
            local ls = T.Lines(T.Digits(line), w * 0.94, size, T.Mode())
            if type(ls) ~= "table" then
                return nil
            end
            if #ls == 0 then
                out[#out + 1] = ""
            end
            for _, s in ipairs(ls) do
                out[#out + 1] = s
            end
        else
            local s = T.ShapeLine(T.Digits(line), T.Mode())
            if type(s) ~= "string" then
                return nil
            end
            out[#out + 1] = s
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out, "\n")
end
local oks, shaped = pcall(shape, fa, fs)
